propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for held or orphaned locks; operators must manually inspect lock directories and owner stamps to determine holder identity and process liveness

doctor command must probe four lock legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc fcntl, enrich-drain exclusive) for held/free/absent state and report holder v2 stamp fields (host/ns/pid/start) and liveness without changing lock state
holder liveness must only be probed on the same host and pid namespace; foreign hosts or namespaces must report unprobeable rather than guessing at pid state
staleness determination must exclusively use rebar._store.lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with no independent age threshold or pid probe; stale locks become findings and force exit code 1
doctor is read-only and must never mutate lock state, owner files, or drain lock files; --repair must not perform lock actions
JSON output must validate against updated doctor schema and include locks and lock_findings keys with detailed per-leg state and holder information
